consequence.statement: This change only adds an allowed enum value and removes none, so existing PrometheusAgent resources are still accepted. Operators can now choose the new value.

original.statement: In the monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1 PrometheusAgent CRD schema, spec.otlp.translationStrategy now also accepts "UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes". No previously allowed values were removed, so existing resources are still accepted.

decision.reason: The computed diff behind this change compares the v0.85.0 and v0.86.2 PrometheusAgent CRDs [ev-7d96c48a5c71, ev-4393a79e776d]. It says the enum for spec.otlp.translationStrategy removed no values and only added "UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes". Since nothing was removed, no existing resource can be rejected. One validator (crd-schema:tightened) even reports the enum as unchanged, which also means no operational consequence. So "none" (informational) holds either way, and P1's resource-rejected claims mandatory work the diff does not support. Confidence is low because both excerpts are empty and the two artifact readings disagree on whether the enum changed at all.
